statement: AMD reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.66, ahead of expectations of $11.3 billion and $1.62.
why: A revenue and earnings beat confirms that AI compute demand is showing up in reported results, not just guidance.

impact.mechanism: Revenue above consensus indicates accelerator and server demand is running ahead of what the market had modeled.

evidence.excerpt: earnings per share (EPS) of $1.66 on revenue of $11.5 billion

confidence.basis: Secondary press coverage of AMD's release rather than the filing itself.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 13.0 -> 11.5 (tol 1%); sources: AMD Investor Relations (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.), Yahoo Finance
